projects.name: rusteams
projects.summary: Terminal user interface (TUI) client for Microsoft Teams via official Microsoft Graph APIs.
projects.description: rusteams is a Rust-based TUI client for Microsoft Teams that connects via Microsoft Graph APIs. It features a rich domain model (reactions, mentions, threads, presence), a connection state machine with backoff, terminal-output sanitizer for security, and a polling sync engine. Built with a BYO-app model for Entra ID authentication.
projects.problem: Existing Teams clients are heavy Electron apps. Developers and power users want a lightweight, keyboard-driven terminal client that integrates with their workflow and respects terminal security boundaries.
highlights: Device-code OAuth flow with OS keyring storage (BYO Entra app)
Rich domain: reactions, mentions, threads, presence
Terminal-output sanitizer (ANSI/OSC/C0 stripping)
GraphClient with incremental polling, 429 retry, paging
Offline test suites: unit, contract, property tests with MockTeamsProvider
Composer buffer + palette filter models with optimistic-send flow
Live event loop with crossterm feed, action fold, re-render

projects.name: TaskY
projects.summary: Multi-tenant work and time-management monorepo with Java/Spring Boot API, React SPA, and PostgreSQL.
projects.description: TaskY is a full-stack monorepo for multi-tenant work and time management. The API is built with Java 21, Spring Boot 4, Spring Security, JPA, and Flyway on PostgreSQL 16. The frontend uses React 19, TypeScript, Vite 6, TanStack Query, Zustand, Tailwind 4, and Radix UI. Includes Google OAuth authentication, JWT access tokens with rotating refresh cookies, and tenant-scoped authorization.
projects.problem: Teams need a self-hostable, multi-tenant time-tracking solution with proper authorization boundaries, audit trails, and modern UX — without vendor lock-in or per-seat SaaS pricing.
highlights: Multi-tenant architecture with tenant-scoped queries
Google OAuth with rotating HttpOnly refresh cookies
JWT access tokens in browser memory (Bearer auth)
Spring Security + JPA + Flyway migrations
React 19 + TanStack Query + Zustand state management
Radix UI primitives with Tailwind 4 styling
Testcontainers integration tests + Vitest/MSW frontend tests
GitHub Actions CI with CodeQL, Gitleaks, container scans, SBOM

projects.name: devenv
projects.summary: A suite of reproducible, non-root DevContainer base and language images built on Debian, Ubuntu, Alpine, and Arch Linux.
projects.description: devenv provides a curated collection of DevContainer images for 30+ programming languages. Each image ships a `developer` user (UID 1000) with passwordless sudo/doas, ZSH + Spaceship prompt, and Nerd Fonts. Dotfiles are sourced from the dottod submodule for workstation parity. Images declare VOLUMEs for dependency caches so they survive container rebuilds. Published at devenv.lucasvmigotto.me and GHCR/Docker Hub.
projects.problem: Development environments drift across machines and team members. Existing DevContainer images are either too minimal or too opinionated. Teams need a comprehensive, versioned image catalog with consistent tooling and cache persistence.
highlights: 30+ language images: Java, Go, Rust, Python, .NET, Flutter, Node, Zig, C/C++, and more
4 base distros: Debian (trixie/bookworm), Ubuntu (noble/jammy), Alpine (3.21-3.23), Arch Linux
Non-root `developer` user (UID 1000) with sudo/doas
ZSH + Spaceship prompt + Nerd Fonts (FiraCode, FiraMono, SymbolsOnly)
Dotfiles via dottod git submodule for workstation parity
Cache VOLUMEs for Gradle, Cargo, uv, npm, Go, .NET, etc.
Buildx multi-arch CI with SLSA provenance (GHCR + Docker Hub)
Declarative matrix in manifest.json — add languages without workflow changes

projects.name: dottod
projects.summary: Personal dotfiles and workstation bootstrap for Debian (GNOME) with bash scripts and a Rust TUI.
projects.description: dottod reproducibly recreates a complete developer workstation: Zsh + Oh My Zsh + Spaceship prompt (with system-info segment), Nerd Fonts, Neovim/Vim, container runtime (Podman by default), GitHub SSH config, and CLI tooling. Includes both a bash bootstrap orchestrator and an interactive Ratatui TUI. Prebuilt releases available for zero-Rust installation.
projects.problem: Setting up a new machine is tedious and error-prone. Existing dotfile managers are either too complex (chezmoi templates) or too minimal. dottod provides a complete, idempotent bootstrap with both script and TUI interfaces.
highlights: 10 modular bootstrap tasks: shell, fonts, vim, neovim, container, desktop, vscode, ghostty, gitconfig, ssh, tools
Interactive Ratatui TUI with vim-like keybindings (j/k, palette, runtime cycling)
Prebuilt releases: scripts tarball + compiled binary + checksums
Idempotent: checks existing installs, backs up dotfiles (.dottod.bak)
Parallel execution with `--parallel` flag
BATS + zsh test suites with hermetic fixtures
Container runtime selection: Podman (default) or Docker

projects.name: lucasvmigotto (this portfolio)
projects.summary: Personal portfolio website — React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, Bun, i18n, PDF generation.
projects.description: This portfolio site. A single-page, fully static, client-side-rendered SPA deployed as static assets behind Nginx in a Docker container. Features dark-field design system, bilingual content (EN/PT-BR), scroll-reveal animations, and client-side PDF resume generation.
projects.problem: Personal sites often become over-engineered (Next.js for a static page) or under-engineered (no i18n, no a11y, no build pipeline). This project demonstrates a minimal, production-grade stack that's fast, accessible, and maintainable.
highlights: Zero-server static SPA with Docker + Nginx deployment
Full i18n (EN/PT-BR) with locale-aware formatting
WCAG 2.2 AA target with automated axe-core testing
Client-side PDF generation from same data source
Lighthouse CI gated in CI/CD
